	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
	username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

	role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (id),

)

CREATE TABLE voting_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
	election_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
	device_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
	session_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	voter_credential VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
	authorized_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	voted_at DATETIME,
	expired_at DATETIME,
	PRIMARY KEY (id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_voter_credential UNIQUE (election_id, voter_credential),
	FOREIGN KEY(election_id) REFERENCES elections (id),
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id),
	UNIQUE (session_token)
)

CREATE TABLE ballots (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
	election_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
	device_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
	candidate_id VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
	sequence_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
	ballot_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_device_sequence UNIQUE (device_id, sequence_number),
	FOREIGN KEY(election_id) REFERENCES elections (id),
	UNIQUE (session_id),
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES voting_sessions (id),
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id),
	FOREIGN KEY(candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates (id)
)
